comment: mkmaze.c baalz_fixup() when #wizloaddes loads another level file (minefill) on Baalzebub's level: fixup_special() still calls it, the middle row has no nondiggable square, so bughack.inarea.x1 stays COLNO and C reads levl[COLNO][y], which aliases svl.level.objects[0][y] and finds no flag; wallification() then covers columns 78-79 of rows 19-20.
